cohort: The study included 6,406 very premature and very low birth weight infants from the Neonatal Research Network of Japan (NRNJ) and 2,319 from the Brazilian Network on Neonatal Research (RBPN) in participating NICUs.
finding: Very premature and very low birth weight infants from Brazil had significantly higher odds for mortality and lower odds for survival without major morbidities compared to those from Japan.
